conclusion: The installed identifier 37.0 is consistent with the pinned current SDK major/minor model. The CI helper's integer-only str.isdigit() check, not a proven defective SDK installation, caused the archived pre-Gradle refusal.
limits: Cached JAR/POM and SDK hashes identify inspected bytes, not independent authenticity/provenance or an attestation of code loaded by a particular Gradle process.
No SDK/plugin classes were executed. AGP/schema call-path observations are bytecode evidence, not a successful Android build or runtime test.
The strict CI grammar does not imitate permissive extension/preview/parse-error fallbacks in every SDK parser.
The approved correction preserves existing key/value whitespace stripping and the exact normalized version identifier; it does not preserve the raw source.properties RHS.
